name: National Scholarship Portal
full_name: National Scholarship Portal - Central & State Scholarships
benefit: Scholarships ₹5,000-₹50,000+ per year for students from Class 1 to PhD level
benefit_hindi: ₹5,000 se ₹50,000+ saalana chhaatravritti, Class 1 se PhD tak

eligibility.description: Students from economically weaker sections, SC/ST/OBC/Minority communities
eligibility.description_hindi: Kamzor aarthik varg, SC/ST/OBC/Alpsankhyak samuday ke chhaatr
criteria: Family annual income below ₹2-8 lakh (varies by scheme)
exclusions: Students already receiving scholarship from another source

steps: Fill application form with required details
steps_hindi: Submit karein aur status track karein

hindi_summary: National Scholarship Portal par Class 1 se PhD tak ke chhaatr scholarship ke liye apply kar sakte hain. SC/ST/OBC/Minority chhaatr ko 5000 se 50000 rupaye tak milte hain. scholarships.gov.in par online apply karein.
